header: The page's plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs: the launcher, Load ROM on a new profile once the shader
list Chrome builds behind it is done (Firefox builds none there and says so), Start Game, the title and the attract
race, which play by themselves, about 60 s, then through the menus as a player (keys held 150 ms: A Space, B Left
Shift, Start Enter) to three races in one load, each left by the pause menu's QUIT and YES: PRACTICE on track 1 and
track 3 and STUNT's first arena, about 50 s each. The menus go by the game's own state (0x801174B4, a bit a screen:
0x10 the main menu, 0x20 the player select, 0x40 SELECT MODE, 0x80 SELECT TRACK, 0x100 the car select, 0x400000 a
race) and each menu's cursor; each race's start is a need that the game is racing on the track asked for (0x8014978C:
0 and 2 the first and third tracks, 14 the first stunt arena). PRACTICE has no time limit, so a race driven blind
plays on. Each is driven with the gas held and a light weave, its waits and holds on the race clock (0x801543CC,
seconds, stopped while paused), with a shot about 8 s in.
load: RT64: all \d+ prebuilt shaders built|once the game draws
